release.content: pubkit 0.12.1 was released on 2026-10-20 from commit 6d8202e68797937c429e1028dd3e51c70240f562 with these changes.

rows: Rewrites the two regular expressions SonarQube Cloud still found backtracking (the tool version and the standard's [checked] tags), and passes cargo and pubrel only values pubkit has checked: the crate's name from cargo metadata, a row's text that cannot start with '-', and the --report path once confined

rust-ci's sonar job also reads Cobertura XML a functional target writes in coverage/ (coverage/*.xml) as sonar.python.coverage.reportPaths, so a Rust repository's Python scripts count toward coverage on new code
